description: This file implements the ControlIpc class and related factory functions for inter-process communication (IPC) in the Rialto client, handling shared memory, client registration, and event subscriptions.

classes.name: IControlIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating ControlIpc instances.

classes.name: ControlIpc
classes.description: Implements IPC control functionalities, including shared memory retrieval, client registration, and event handling.

methods.name: convertApplicationState
methods.description: Converts application state enum from event to internal representation.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ControlIpcFactory.

methods.name: getControlIpc
methods.description: Creates a ControlIpc instance with provided control client.

methods.name: ControlIpc
methods.description: Constructor initializing IPC channel and event thread.

methods.name: ~ControlIpc
methods.description: Destructor detaching IPC channel and resetting event thread.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Retrieves shared memory file descriptor and size via IPC.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers the client with the IPC server.

methods.name: createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates RPC stubs for IPC communication.

methods.name: subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to application state change and ping events.

methods.name: onPing
methods.description: Handles ping events and sends acknowledgment.
